title: Which country will host Ye Win Oo's first overseas visit as Myanmar's military chief?
background: Ye Win Oo assumed Myanmar's military leadership in April 2026 after Min Aung Hlaing became president.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official statements from the governments involved or contemporaneous reporting by major international news organizations identifying the destination of Ye Win Oo's first overseas visit after assuming military leadership in April 2026.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve once the visit has begun and is publicly confirmed, rather than when travel plans are merely announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The destination country's common English name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: No foreign trip reported as of Jul 21. On Jul 17 Ye Win Oo inspected the first-ever Myanmar-Russia joint exercise (Tiger-2026) in Naypyitaw and cited regular reciprocal visits by the two armed forces' chiefs, so Russia gets a slight edge over China.

title: Who will win the 2026 Republican primary for Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District?
background: Andy Ogles has represented Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2023.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Tennessee election results, with a definitive Associated Press race call accepted before certification.
  • Resolution Event: The determination of the winner of the Republican primary for Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District scheduled for August 6, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate’s full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Ogles keeps Trump's endorsement, but Jul 13-20 reports (Tennessean, WPLN, Banner) show a closer race: Hatcher out-raised him ($187k cash vs Ogles $67k + $70k debt), was endorsed by Haslam (Jul 16), Perdue, Corker and Wamp, and his internal poll shows a 'virtual tie'; 83% of voters are new to the redrawn district. Early voting runs Jul 17-Aug 1.

title: What source of cocaine exposure will UK Anti-Doping cite when publicly explaining the resolution of Joseph Parker's October 2025 doping case?
background: Joseph Parker is a former world heavyweight boxing champion from New Zealand. He tested positive for cocaine in connection with his October 2025 fight against Fabio Wardley and has denied knowingly taking banned substances.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UK Anti-Doping's official decision or public statement explaining the resolution of Parker's case arising from the cocaine tests associated with his October 2025 bout.
  • Resolution: Resolve when UK Anti-Doping publicly identifies the source of Parker's cocaine exposure in its explanation of the case's resolution. Use the source identified by the agency.
  • Accepted Answer Format: A concise noun phrase identifying the stated source of exposure.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: No UKAD ruling yet. In Dec 2025 Parker asked 'Why did I have that cup of tea?' On Jul 8 2026 adviser Spencer Brown cited 'contamination', 'the people around him at the time' and witness statements, and expects a reduced ban, which points to third-party contamination of a drink or contact.

title: Which districts will hold polling on August 10 in Pakistan-administered Kashmir's 2026 Legislative Assembly election?
background: Pakistan-administered Kashmir's 2026 Legislative Assembly election is scheduled to take place in three phases.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official election-authority records or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the districts where polling takes place on August 10, 2026.
  • Resolution: The answer will be the complete set of districts within Pakistan-administered Kashmir where Legislative Assembly polling opens on that date.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The district names, joined by “and”.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: On Jul 21 AJK Chief Election Commissioner Ghulam Mustafa Mughal announced a three-phase poll (Tribune, The News, Daily Pakistan): Mirpur Division Jul 27, Muzaffarabad Division plus refugee seats Aug 2, and Poonch Division (Poonch/Rawalakot, Bagh, Sudhnoti, Haveli) Aug 10, with postponement calls rejected. The small residual covers a further delay in unrest-hit Rawalakot/Sudhnoti.

title: Which major US employment sector will shed the most jobs in July 2026?
background: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics reports monthly changes in nonfarm payroll employment by sector.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the broad employment sector with the largest net decline in payroll jobs in July 2026, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics' initial employment report for that month, released in August 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-07
  • Accepted Answer Format: Compare sectors by the number of jobs lost, not percentage changes, and count subsectors within their parent sectors. Answer with the sector's name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: June report (Jul 2): leisure and hospitality -61k, information -9k, trade/transportation/utilities -4k (retail -7.5k), mining -4k, financial activities flat after -22k in May; the labour force is shrinking. Subsectors count within parents, so Retail trade was replaced by Trade, transportation, and utilities; volatile large sectors are favoured for the biggest July decline.

title: From which UK city will the aid boat Kate depart on its Gaza mission in August 2026?
background: The Freedom Flotilla organizes sea voyages aimed at delivering aid to Gaza and challenging Israel's blockade.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the UK city from which Kate sets sail in August 2026 as part of a Freedom Flotilla effort to reach Gaza, according to contemporaneous reporting of its departure.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-16
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the city name.

title: Who will win the main MotoGP race at the 2026 British Grand Prix?
background: The main Grand Prix race is separate from the sprint race held during the same MotoGP weekend.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official MotoGP classification for the 2026 British Grand Prix main race at Silverstone.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the rider declared the winner of the main race scheduled for August 9, 2026. The sprint race does not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning rider's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Marc Marquez dominated the German GP on Jul 12 (sprint and GP double, his 3rd GP win in 4 races) and is 18 pts behind leader Martin (5th). Ogura has 3 straight podiums. Bezzecchi, the 2025 Silverstone winner, fractured his collarbone in Sachsenring qualifying ('complicated' surgery plus a Jul 18 knee procedure); he targets an Aug 9 return but has scored only 13 of 148 points in 4 rounds.

title: Which country will become the second, after the United States, to formally recognise Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights by the end of 2026?
background: The United States formally recognised Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights in 2019. Most of the international community has rejected Israel’s annexation of the territory.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official national government announcements, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the first country other than the United States whose national government publicly announces formal recognition of Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights between January 1 and December 31, 2026. Support for Israeli security interests without explicit recognition of sovereignty does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country’s common English name.
last_rationale: Colombia pro-Israel president takes office Aug 7

title: Who will win the Republican primary for Alabama's 2nd Congressional District on August 11, 2026?
background: The primary will determine the Republican nominee for this U.S. House seat in the November 2026 general election.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Associated Press's results and reporting for Alabama's August 11, 2026 Republican primary in the 2nd Congressional District.
  • Resolution: Resolve when AP identifies the candidate who has secured the nomination. A preliminary lead or advancement to a runoff does not count as winning the nomination.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Trump gave Marques a 'Complete and Total Endorsement' on Jun 22, adding to Britt, Speaker Ledbetter and ALFA. He was the only candidate on TV ($200k+ buy, Jul 14) and led the June poll 30-10. The Aug 11 special primary is plurality with no runoff.

title: Which stadium will Shakhtar Donetsk announce an agreement to use for its home matches in the main phase of the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League?
background: War has prevented Shakhtar Donetsk from hosting European matches in Ukraine, forcing the club to arrange alternative venues abroad.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official Shakhtar Donetsk announcement, or reliable reporting quoting the club, identifying its agreed home venue for the 2026–27 Champions League main phase.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the stadium named in the first such agreement announced by August 31, 2026. The announcement determines the answer; subsequent regulatory approval or the actual staging of matches is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The stadium’s name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Jul 17-20: journalist Ihor Burbas (who first broke the Brentford talks) says the 17k Gtech was dropped as too small and Shakhtar is choosing between Stamford Bridge (40k) and Craven Cottage. The Athletic/Standard (Jul 19-20) say Chelsea, Fulham and Brentford were all contacted, Chelsea is keen for revenue, and a decision is imminent.

title: What will be the furthest stage Inter Miami reaches in the 2026 Leagues Cup?
background: The Leagues Cup features clubs from Major League Soccer and Mexico’s Liga MX. Inter Miami won the tournament in 2023 and finished as runners-up in 2025.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Leagues Cup results or reliable contemporaneous match reports covering Inter Miami’s participation in the 2026 tournament.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve once Inter Miami is eliminated or completes the tournament final. The answer is the furthest tournament stage in which the club plays.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide only the name of the tournament stage.

title: Which Israeli company will Save the Children Norway urge Norway's sovereign wealth fund to divest from by September 20, 2026?
background: Norway's sovereign wealth fund reduced its holdings in Israeli companies in 2025, citing the humanitarian crisis in Gaza.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the Israeli company publicly identified by Save the Children Norway or its representatives as a divestment target over concerns that its products could contribute to violations of international humanitarian law. Use statements or contemporaneous reporting published between January 1 and September 20, 2026. Answer with the company's full name.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-20
  • Accepted Answer Format: string (company)
last_rationale: Redd Barna's Harlem reacted strongly to ICL (white phosphorus) Aug 2025; 'products could contribute' fits ICL

title: Which branch of Venezuela's government will the first government–opposition talks after Nicolás Maduro's removal agree to overhaul?
background: Nicolás Maduro was removed from power in January 2026, and Delcy Rodríguez became acting president. Previous negotiations between Venezuela's government and opposition have not produced a lasting political settlement.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements from the negotiating parties or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the branch of government that both sides agree to comprehensively overhaul during their first formal negotiating round following Maduro's January 2026 removal. The round must conclude by August 31, 2026. An announced agreement is sufficient; implementation is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The common name of the governmental branch, rather than an individual institution or officeholder.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Jul 14: the National Assembly (Jorge Rodriguez) and Figuera's 2015-AN opposition announced formal talks from Aug 1 (Rubio Jul 20: first week of August). Their stated priority is 'strengthening the electoral system'; Figuera returned to push CNE renewal and outlets headline 'reforma electoral'. The TSJ is also on the agenda, so Judicial is the main alternative.

title: Which country's mainland coastline will be confirmed contaminated by the Caroline Bezengi oil spill by August 13, 2026?
background: The Caroline Bezengi has been leaking crude oil since running aground in June 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements by government environmental authorities, or reliable news reports directly citing those statements.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the country whose mainland coastline is confirmed to have been contaminated by oil from the Caroline Bezengi by August 13, 2026. Offshore pollution, contamination confined to islands, and predictions of future landfall do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Reuters Jul 17 and Maritime Executive/NSJ Jul 21: the Caroline Bezengi ran aground on Al Qibliyah (Hallaniyat Islands, off Dhofar, Oman) and is breaking up. Sentinel images Jul 2-13 show a slick in this protected area, and Oman surveyed the ship on Jul 12. Contamination is expected to reach the Dhofar coast; the island exclusion fits this location.

title: Which two countries will reach the final of the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations?
background: The Women's Africa Cup of Nations is Africa's continental championship for women's national football teams. The winners of its two semifinals advance to the final.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: CAF's official tournament results, supported where necessary by contemporaneous match reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve once both semifinals of the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations have concluded and the two finalists have been determined. The result of the final itself is not relevant.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The two finalist country names in alphabetical order, separated by a comma.

title: Who will win the women's singles title at the 2026 Canadian Open?
background: The Canadian Open is a major hard-court tennis tournament held during the build-up to the US Open.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official WTA results for the 2026 Canadian Open will determine the women's singles champion.
  • Resolution Timing: The question resolves when the tournament's women's singles final is completed and its result is officially recorded.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the winning player's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Toronto entry list (Jul 8) has 9 of the top 10, and world No.1 Sabalenka is entered (she skipped Canada in 2025) with a 23-1 hard-court record in 2026 and the Sunshine Double. Defending champion Mboko (Jul 7, knee) and Wimbledon finalist Muchova (Jul 18, surgery) withdrew; the draw is Jul 31 and the event runs Aug 2-13.

title: Which country will the Spanish Football Federation announce as the host of the 2027 Spanish Super Cup?
background: The Spanish Super Cup features the winners and runners-up of La Liga and the Copa del Rey. Saudi Arabia has hosted the competition since 2020.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Spanish Football Federation’s official host announcement, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the country officially named as host of the 2027 Spanish Super Cup by August 31, 2026. This question concerns the announced host, not whether the tournament subsequently takes place there. Resolution occurs when the announcement is made.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the host country, rather than the host city or stadium.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: RFEF assembly (Jun 30): Saudi is out for Feb 5-7 2027 because of the Asian Cup, with proposals but 'no firm offers'. Marca-based reports (Jul 18-19) list Mexico (formal FMF bid), the US, Egypt, China and Qatar, and say Qatar's bid is weakened by regional security after the Iran war resumed Jul 15. A decision is expected 'in the coming months' (the 2026 venue was only announced Sep 29), so an announcement before Aug 31 is uncertain.
